# Legacy Architect RVA

> Legacy Architect RVA facilitates Life Manuals for individuals, families, and business owners in Richmond, Virginia: structured documents that let a chosen successor act immediately if something happens to the person who normally runs the household, finances, or business. Founder Craig Rothchild works with each client directly, session by session. This is facilitation, not legal, financial, or medical advice, and no client credentials are ever retained.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://legacyarchitectrva.com/): What a Life Manual is and the problem it solves.
- [Services & Editions](https://legacyarchitectrva.com/services): Pricing for the Just-In-Case Plan, Blueprint Session, and the Vault, Archive, and Legacy Life Manual editions.
- [The 7 Pillars](https://legacyarchitectrva.com/pillars): The seven areas every Life Manual documents, from digital access to business continuity.
- [About](https://legacyarchitectrva.com/about): Craig Rothchild's background and the approach behind the business.
- [FAQ](https://legacyarchitectrva.com/faq): Common questions about the process, pricing, and what each edition includes.
- [Readiness Check](https://legacyarchitectrva.com/readiness): A free, two-minute self-assessment across the seven pillars.
- [Resources](https://legacyarchitectrva.com/resources): Articles and guides on continuity and successor planning.
- [Privacy](https://legacyarchitectrva.com/privacy): Privacy policy.
- [Terms](https://legacyarchitectrva.com/terms): Terms of service.

## Notes

- Legacy Architect RVA is a facilitation service, not a law firm, financial advisory, or investment service, and does not give legal, financial, tax, or investment advice.
- No client credentials, passwords, or account access are retained; clients control their own secure drive.
- Scheduling a private conversation: https://cal.com/legacyarchitectrva/private-conversation
